name: Sled Pull
steps: Stand facing a weighted sled with its attached rope pulled taut, hinge into a strong athletic stance, and grip the rope with both hands.
Brace your core, lean slightly back against the weight, and pull one hand powerfully toward your hip while reaching forward with the other.
Continue pulling hand over hand in a steady alternating rhythm to drag the sled across the floor toward you.
Finish cleanly when the sled reaches your position while keeping your spine neutral and stance grounded.
tips: Sit your hips low and brace your back flat so your lats and legs work together without rounding your spine.
Take long, decisive reaches and pull smoothly to keep the sled gliding without stalling.
